en.headline: Cathay Pacific warns of delays after US ground stop hits Hong Kong-bound flights
en.dek: The airline said two flights from the United States were delayed by a temporary nationwide grounding caused by air traffic communications issues, while other US services run on schedule.
body: Cathay Pacific said on Saturday that two of its Hong Kong-bound flights from the United States had been delayed by a nationwide ground stop ordered by the US Federal Aviation Administration.

The airline identified the affected services as CX807 and CX879. It stated that the remaining flights between Hong Kong and the United States were operating according to their schedules but warned that congestion from the earlier disruption could cause further delays.

The ground stop, which lasted about four hours, was lifted after a communications failure at regional air traffic control centres. Cathay Pacific said it was working with air traffic control authorities and the airport to manage the impact on its operations.

zh.headline: 國泰指兩班美國返港航班延誤 其餘航班按原定時間運作
zh.dek: 航空公司表示，受美國聯邦航空管理局因空中交通通訊問題實施的短暫全國停飛令影響，兩班航班延誤，並提醒可能出現進一步擠塞。
body: 國泰航空周六表示，兩班由美國飛往香港的航班因美國聯邦航空管理局發出的全國停飛令而延誤。
航空公司指出受影響的是CX807及CX879航班。其餘往返美國的國泰航班目前均按原定時間運作，但警告早前的停飛可能導致擠塞，部分航班或再出現延誤。
停飛令持續約四小時後已解除，原因是地區空中交通管制中心出現通訊故障。國泰表示正與航空交通管制部門及機場當局合作，處理相關影響。
